text_block_list.text: (Hoooot! Clang, clang, clang!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong-dong, choo choo! Watching the 
steamboat travel down the Mississippi 
River... the children dream.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'd think, "Someday, I wanna go on a grand 
adventure on a ship like this too!" But—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
When people become adults, for some reason 
they forget their dreams and step off that 
ship of their own accord.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe it? You've gotta be 
kidding me! Don't you feel it too? Wanting 
to 'keep chasing your dreams for your 
whole life.'

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll decide my own path! And live in a 
place where I can dance the night away 
with my beloved friends forever!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's my dream!! Of course it is! Like 
I'd ever forget the spirit of adventure or 
friendship!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Even so, right now we're homeless and 
penniless, without even a proper place to 
gather. But...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely build a "castle" where 
we can stay together forever! So—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Join me! Come on, follow my lead!"

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!

At the barbecue area on the riverbank, the 
Umamusume and high school girls who 
admired her burst into cheers.

This Umamusume is Tap Dance City, my 
partner— a seeker of romance who came all 
the way from America.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Still, even if they call it a castle you 
can stay in forever, it must be pretty 
tough, huh~?"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...True. It's not like we can just take 
the castle we visited on our field trip, 
after all~."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. "Reality" is harsh. So 
here's a question. What kind of power do 
you need to beat down reality?"

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
The power that's needed... To defeat 
reality... is it reality after all?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! We need "practical power" on our 
side too. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Money, obviously!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Win in the Twinkle Series, make a name for 
ourselves, and snatch up the attention of 
sponsors worldwide!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If we do that, we'll gather everything we 
want and even build a "castle"! —Right, 
Trainer?

"In the world of professional sports, you 
need 'true ability' to achieve anything."

"If you win, you get glory, praise, and 
funds. On the other hand, if you don't 
win, you get nothing."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Winner takes all. Fine by me. If I can't 
even keep laughing with my friends unless 
I win—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nothing less than a massive victory! Just 
like that Umamusume who snatched the 
world's attention in one fell swoop that 
day!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text: Tap, that Umamusume is...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? It was a few years ago. 
In the Japan Cup, the race to decide the 
world's strongest Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Up against Symboli Rudolf, Mr. C.B., and a 
formidable host of international 
challengers, the one who pulled off a 
massive upset was—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It's Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
She was the 10th favorite. With no one 
paying attention, Ace—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I pulled off a victory with an unexpected 
runaway lead! Made the whole world gasp in 
awe, too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
When I was still a kid, watching it on 
cable TV made my blood boil with 
excitement...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And that got me thinking! I'm gonna go to 
that country too! I'll seize that massive 
dream for myself!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
And once I grew up, I really came to this 
country, and I—

text_block_list.name: High School Girl with Twintails
text_block_list.text:
So you had nowhere to go and were in a 
bind, until we came along and helped you 
out, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ahahaha, you're right. That did 
happen, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was a castaway... Kinda like a 
driftin' castaway back then.

Yes... At that time, Tap Dance City was 
saved by her current companions.

"That is precisely why she seems to feel 
so strongly about using her own running 
from now on to help peers who find 
themselves at a dead end regarding their 
future and career paths."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Even so, right now, I don't have anything 
besides my dreams and my friends.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
To build my ultimate goal, a "castle" 
where everyone can smile together... what 
should I do, Trainer?
choice_data_list: A plan? — I have one, you know.

text_block_list.text:
With that said, I unfold the large sheet 
of paper I prepared in front of everyone.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text: Is this... a schedule plan?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oho, so in other words, a "road map"? 
Pretty thoughtful of you.

Tap Dance City flashes a grin. Yes, this 
is our nautical chart for the Twinkle 
Series.

Going forward blindly will never get us to 
our goal. First, we needed to chart a 
concrete course.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. While debuting and polishing 
your running ability, at the same time—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"First, let's create a small hangout spot 
where everyone can spend time together. 
Meaning—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: So you're "building a base," huh?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, before the castle, you need a "place 
to belong"

Yeah, before a castle, you need a "place 
to belong."

text_block_list.text:
Right now, we are no different from 
rootless weeds. Leaving things as they are 
is far too unsettling.

First, build a base of operations. In 
other words, 'securing a stronghold' was 
necessary.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice! But first things first, should 
we go take over some uninhabited island?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Still, Tap. Thinking realistically... 
building a base from scratch is pretty 
tough, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Right~? There are all sorts of tiny, 
detailed numbers written on this plan too~

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, she's quite the perfectionist, 
after all. Our dear Navigator, that is.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Sometimes I have no idea what she's 
thinking. But that's what makes her 
great!"

It might seem overly pedantic, sure. But 
grounding plans in solid numbers and 
theory has always been my policy.

If you don't make a proper strategy before 
a match, you can't call yourself a true 
gambler. Even if not everyone understands 
it.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, is it really okay for me to just go 
all-in with the hype without really 
understanding...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Tsk, tsk, tsk. What matters isn't those 
tiny details. Look at the bottom—the very 
bottom of the nautical chart."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's written right there, plain as day. 
See...!

Tap Dance City points to the very bottom 
of the chart. Written there were my own 
words.
We will win！

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text: We, will... Um...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"‘We are going to win!’ Our determination 
is one and the same."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Win races! Make a name for myself! Get 
rich! And then, keep laughing forever with 
the ones I love!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Right?

Tap Dance City gives a wink. Yes, in the 
end—there was only one goal.

Combining my strength with Tap Dance 
City's to overcome the rough seas. Unless 
we can do that... we won't be able to 
seize the future.

"I just want to keep smiling with the 
people I love." Even a modest dream like 
that can't come true in this competitive 
world.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Go forward! Come, let's go. I won't 
question anyone's individual colors.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The dreams we bring can be of any color. 
Aiming for a castle where everyone can 
stay true to themselves and laugh together 
forever—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Now, set sail—!

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Oh!
(FLAP!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
W-What's with this flag? It's just a bunch 
of rags stitched together...

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Well, since we're here, I thought 
I'd try making one~

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha, this is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Awesome!!

A handmade flag stitched together from 
rags fluttering against the sky.

She may look battered on the outside, but 
she has a heart of gold. The voyage of Tap 
Dance City and her crew was about to begin 
right here.
